description: The source report specifies input-data requirements for early-stage simulation of large thermal-storage integration in district heating. It identifies datasets needed for baseline analysis and technical/economic comparisons, potential sources, stage-specific relevance and approaches to missing inputs. The resource is a source-defined simulation-input reference document. It is not the underlying datasets it describes, and the native description does not expose the individual source catalogue rows or endpoints needed to enumerate those references. The source authors provide the native description and file descriptors through Zenodo. Only metadata was inspected; no measurements, archives, source code or document bodies were retrieved. Coverage remains bounded to the named experiments, with other geographic and temporal fields unknown. Related project resources may overlap; common project membership does not establish identical simulation inputs or results. The native deposit declares CC-BY-4.0 and public access without a stated charge.
